title: Goal Result
description: A seller's evaluation of one planning goal against one proposal version. A proposal answering criteria.planning_goals carries one result per goal present in the request's effective planning_goals, and MUST NOT silently ignore a goal: one it cannot plan against is reported not_supported. Results are the seller's evaluation of its own forecast, a statement of what the plan is expected to do and not a delivery guarantee.

window.description: For max_frequency, the window achieved was measured over, as in the request.

target.description: The figure the buyer asked for, in the goal's unit (see planning-goal-key.json). Absent for goals with no single figure.

achieved.description: The figure the proposal is forecast to deliver, in the same unit as target.

detail.description: Why the goal was met or missed, or what the seller could not support, in prose an agent can relay.

unmet_items.description: For must_include, what the plan omits; for must_exclude, what it still contains. Market labels and programming formats as the buyer sent them; a station as type:value (station_id:WBZ-AM).
